title: Memory pressure and paging
description: Available memory falls below 400 MB, hard faults climb to ~900/s, and frames stall waiting on the page file.

events.title: Memory pressure and paging
events.whatHappened: Frame time rose to 111 ms while the machine was fetching 1099 memory pages per second from disk.
events.mechanism: The game needed memory that had been paged out to disk. Each miss stalls the thread until the page is read back, and disk reads are thousands of times slower than memory.
events.recommendedAction: Close memory-heavy applications before playing, or reduce texture and streaming settings. More RAM is the durable fix if this recurs.

evidence.statement: Disk response time rose to 16.9 ms serving those faults

ruledOut.title: Background CPU contention
ruledOut.reason: Total CPU load did not rise materially (peak 43%).

ruledOut.title: CPU frequency collapse
ruledOut.reason: CPU effective clock stayed near 4.60 GHz.

ruledOut.title: GPU thermal throttling
ruledOut.reason: GPU peaked at 66 C with no thermal limit reported.

ruledOut.title: GPU power limit
ruledOut.reason: The GPU reported nothing as the reason for its clocks.

ruledOut.title: Storage stall
ruledOut.reason: Disk was slow, but 1099 hard faults/s indicate memory paging rather than a storage fault.

ruledOut.title: Driver interrupt latency
ruledOut.reason: Kernel-mode time stayed at 0.7% (deferred calls and interrupts).
